scope: Isolated review-availability tooling diff; no production assets/ledger or provider calls

findings.defect: Provider provenance accepts rebinding an unchanged verdict to different reviewed bytes.
findings.evidence: Mocked original request passed; changing provider_evidence.bindings.film_sha256 and reviewed_preflight_sha256 together returned []. The raw response and response hash stayed unchanged. prompt_sha256/input_sha256 are only checked for nonempty values; no retained request/event/cache record is checked by downstream gates.
findings.required_fix: Verify a retained immutable transport request/response receipt against its ledger event and current input identities; reject edited bindings and timestamps even when projected report fields match. Add negative simultaneous-rebinding coverage for film, renderer, claims and action module.

findings.defect: Recovery reviewer cannot inspect all required current evidence.
findings.evidence: packet sends selected JSON and renderer text plus MP4/feed, but excludes CREATIVE_DIRECTION.md, referenced source evidence and native asset pixels, comparison/selection artifacts, prior shipped-media reuse evidence and current attention player/contact sheet. The remote provider has no filesystem tools to open the supplied local paths. storyboard-critic.md explicitly requires actual referenced sources/native assets and both complete treatments; daily_production.packet also binds creative direction/comparison/selection and attention player.
findings.required_fix: Build a bounded self-contained role packet from the ordinary mandatory inputs; attach required current source/native images, comparison evidence and attention artifacts, preserve exact hashes, and fail closed on missing required inputs. Add real packet coverage tests instead of exclusively mocking packet.

findings.defect: Recovery is not bound to an actual reserved uncompleted independent role.
findings.evidence: failure_problems accepts any nonempty actor/time and supported error. run checks no host assignment reservation or completion state for code/phone. Existing test fixture makes a phone request with zero storyboard_critics usage; this review reproduced that accepted request. Nothing rejects an already-completed host verdict or binds the error file to the exact assigned worker/event/current review scope.
findings.required_fix: Require exact retained charged assignment identity/event and observed transport failure for an uncompleted role; refuse a replacement of completed rejection/pass and unknown actors/scopes. Retain separate provider request charges without critic refunds.

findings.defect: Duplicate request guard has a check-then-write race.
findings.evidence: report/attempt existence are checked before reserve and cache.mkdir(exist_ok=True)/attempt.write_text. Two simultaneous invocations can both observe absent attempt, both contact the provider and overwrite response/report files. Atomic os.replace in controller.save does not lock read-modify-write reservation or claim this request identity.
findings.required_fix: Atomically claim a per-input transport attempt before spending/contacting the provider; serialize ledger reservation and preserve each original result. Add simultaneous-call regression proving one provider request and one retained charge.

preserved_properties: Configured audiovisual model remains policy av_model; no model/automation configuration mutation was found.
Provider calls reserve audiovisual_reviews and retain failed attempts; completed provider rejection cache remains unchanged in sequential tests.
Three separate scorer objects, audiovisual receipts, source/release gates and shipped-only routine completion remain required.
limitations: No real provider calls, renders, production changes or concurrent execution reproduction; concurrency finding follows the exact unsynchronized control flow.
